title: ficus alba var. mappan
intro: Ficus alba var. mappan, commonly known as Mappan, is a variety of the Ficus alba tree, native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in treating various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Ficus alba var. mappan are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Regular consumption of Ficus alba var. mappan has been reported to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress.
